title: Design System: Earth Data Detective: Florida

figure.purpose: Readout card numbers with tabular figures; unit at 0.42em in slate. Rolls to new values on place change.

title.purpose: Answer word on a readout card in its verdict colour; place select value.

body.purpose: All reading text, notes, table cells, chart text and hover labels.

lead.purpose: Intro paragraph under a page headline, 62ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked functional labels: card questions, field labels, metric labels, table headers, glossary groups.

shadows.name: beacon-ring
shadows.purpose: Ring around the brand's cyan beacon dot.

shadows.name: active-tab-seam
shadows.purpose: Inner border on the active page tab.

shadows.name: field-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on selects and inputs, paired with a cyan border.

shadows.name: horizon-glow
shadows.value: radial-gradient(min(1000px, 140vw) 420px at 80% -6%, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.20), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(min(760px, 120vw) 320px at 2% -14%, rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.10), transparent 70%)
shadows.purpose: Fixed atmospheric light behind the top 520px of every page (not a shadow; the only ambient light in the system).

shadows.name: verdict-glow
shadows.value: radial-gradient(600px 200px at 0% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 12%, transparent), transparent 70%)
shadows.purpose: Verdict-coloured corner glow inside the verdict panel.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entrance, press scale, arrow nudge, chevron rotation.

motion.name: entrance-rise
motion.value: 520ms ease-out, translateY(10px) and opacity 0 to rest; delays 0/50/90ms, map 120ms, cards 140ms + 55ms each
motion.purpose: One authored entrance per page visit.

motion.name: figure-roll
motion.value: 650ms, exponential ease-out 1 - 2^(-10k), from last value to new value
motion.purpose: Readout figures roll when the place changes; paints the final value directly under reduced motion.

motion.name: state-color
motion.purpose: Background, border and text colour changes.

motion.name: press-scale
motion.value: scale(0.97) over 140ms ease-out; readout card scale(0.985)
motion.purpose: Pressed buttons, nav tabs, download links and cards.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations 1ms; spinner stopped; figure roll off

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: cards two across, hero stacks.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: header not sticky, compact pills, My area answers-first order, 2x2 compact cards.

breakpoints.name: phone-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: metric strip stacks, smaller section gaps.

breakpoints.name: phone-small
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: other card grids, compare pairs and guide grids go single column.

narrative.overview:
Every answer is a live readout on a dark broadcast surface. A near-black ground carries a faint horizon glow (cyan high on the right, orange low on the left) fixed behind the top of every page; on it sit flat console panels separated by 1px seams. The figures are big and thin, the labels small, tracked and uppercase, and a three-segment certainty meter sits under every answer. The feel is mission control reading out telemetry, calm and exact, rather than a dashboard of white stat cards.

The system is dense but legible: a 1200px column, four readouts across on desktop, two by two on a phone, reading text set in a hyperlegible face at 16px with long line-height. Colour is mostly withheld. Cyan marks selection and "very sure", orange is the second data series and the single primary action, amber says "not sure yet", slate says "no real evidence". Depth comes from tone steps and seams, never from drop shadows. Dark is the only theme; outdoor phone legibility is carried by high-contrast text tokens.

Motion is one authored moment per page visit (a short rise of the headline, map and cards) plus the readout figures rolling to their new value when the place changes. Everything else is a quick colour change or a small press scale.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground with a fixed cyan/orange horizon glow, flat panels on 1px seams, no drop shadows.
Sora 300 for big thin figures and headlines; Sora 600 tracked uppercase for labels; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for everything you read.
Certainty is always shown three ways: verdict colour, segments lit on a meter, and the trend line's dash style.
Cyan is the signal colour; orange appears only as the comparison series and the one primary action.
Lucide-style outline icons at 1.75 stroke, inline SVG, no emoji.
One entrance per page visit, figure roll on place change, everything off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Three Ways Rule
rules.body: A verdict is never colour alone. Very sure = cyan, three segments lit, solid trend line. Not sure yet = amber, two segments, dashed line. No real evidence = slate, one segment, dotted line. Any new surface that states a verdict carries the meter or the line style alongside the colour.

rules.name: The One Ignition Rule
rules.body: Orange is the second data series and the one primary action on a page. It is never a decoration, a heading colour, or a second accent for selection.

rules.name: The Tinted Note Rule
rules.body: Notes and the verdict panel take their tone by mixing it into the panel (8% fill, 28-38% border), never by a solid colour block.

rules.name: The Thin Figure Rule
rules.body: Numbers that answer a question are Sora 300 with tabular figures and negative tracking; weight never goes up to make a figure louder, size does.

rules.name: The Reading Face Rule
rules.body: Anything a visitor reads as a sentence (body, notes, table cells, chart text, hover labels) is Atkinson Hyperlegible Next. Sora is for figures, headings, labels and controls.

rules.name: The Answers First Rule
rules.body: On a phone the four readouts appear before the map and before any explanation; nothing is placed between the place picker and the cards.

rules.name: The No Drop Shadow Rule
rules.body: No offset or blurred drop shadows anywhere. A panel separates from the ground by tone and a seam; a state shows by border colour.

dos: **Do** state every verdict three ways: verdict colour, a three-segment meter, and solid / dashed / dotted trend line.
**Do** set answer figures in Sora 300 with tabular figures and a small slate unit at 0.42em.
**Do** separate panels with 1px seams (#1E293B) and tone steps, and show states with border colour.
**Do** keep cyan for selection, focus, links and "very sure"; keep orange for the second series and the one primary action.
**Do** use the uppercase tracked Sora 600 label for functional labels: card questions, field labels, metric labels, table headers.
**Do** put the four readouts directly after the place picker on phones, two by two, with the whole card as the tap target.
**Do** keep one entrance per page visit and turn the figure roll off under reduced motion.
**Do** use inline outline icons at 1.75 stroke, 16-18px.
donts: **Don't** use drop shadows; the only box-shadows are the beacon ring, the inset active-tab seam, and the focus ring.
**Don't** show a verdict by colour alone, and don't use green or red for verdicts; they belong to notes.
**Don't** add a light theme or white stat cards with a blue accent and soft shadows; this world is dark.
**Don't** use orange as a heading, decoration or second selection colour.
**Don't** use emoji or glyph characters as icons.
**Don't** set sentences in Sora or figures in Atkinson.
